leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Vue composable function that detects clicks outside a specified element.
Initialize and manage reactive state to track the visibility of a target element.
Implement an event listener within the composable to capture click events on the document.
Apply conditional logic to hide the target element when a click occurs outside its boundaries.
Integrate the custom composable into a Vue component to control a dropdown or modal.
Bind the composable's reactive state to template directives for dynamic UI updates.
Configure the composable to properly clean up event listeners when the component unmounts.
